strings.app.title: RemapCopilotKey
strings.hint.sendKey: While the Copilot key is held, the target key stays down and is released together with it.
strings.hint.hotkey: Click a box and press a key to capture it; capture mode ends after one key. The Windows key can be captured too (it will also open the Start menu).
strings.hint.runAsAdmin: When checked, the launched application starts with administrator rights (one UAC prompt).
strings.hint.toggleWindow: When checked, pressing the Copilot key again minimizes or restores the existing window instead of starting another instance.
strings.check.reloadOnChange: Reload automatically when the config file changes

strings.msg.confirmRemove.body:
This stops the service and deletes the auto-start registration.

The Copilot key returns to its original Win+Shift+F23 behaviour. Continue?

strings.msg.removed.body: The service was stopped and the auto-start registration was removed.
strings.msg.registered.title: Registered (but auto-start is broken)
strings.msg.registered.body:
The auto-start task is registered: at the next logon it really will start the service elevated, without a UAC prompt.

But be aware that this path is broken right now — an instance started by the scheduled task runs at low integrity (0x1000) and its keyboard hook receives no keys at all.

Use "Start" instead: it launches the service directly at high integrity (0x3000) and works, at the cost of one UAC prompt. To delete the task, click "Remove".
